qualifier: contractile ring, spindle midzone and abscission
name: Cytokinesis via contractile ring, spindle midzone and abscission
rationale: All members concern late mitotic division (spindle elongation and midzone, RhoA-driven actomyosin and septin rings, furrowing, abscission), unlike confusables centred on nuclear envelope resealing or spindle checkpoint signaling.

name: Fc-gamma receptor-mediated phagocytosis
rationale: Members cover FcγR activation and signaling plus the actin and phospholipid remodelling of the phagocytic cup, distinguishing it from BCR signaling, inhibitory Fc signaling/hypersensitivity, and generic WASP/WAVE actin nucleation.

name: Germinal centre B cell activation with Tfh help
rationale: Members are activated/memory B cell signatures, germinal centre B differentiation and ICOS-dependent Tfh differentiation, whereas confusables are broader B cell, naive B or plasma cell signatures lacking the Tfh/ICOS arm.

name: Meiotic chromosome alignment and poleward segregation
rationale: All three members describe moving meiotic chromosomes to the metaphase plate and toward spindle poles, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, meiotic checkpoints or spindle positioning and polar body extrusion.

qualifier: receptor activation and proximal adaptor events
name: EGFR activation and proximal adaptor signaling
rationale: Members center on EGFR itself (EGFR-ERBB2 dimers, transactivation, overexpression, SHC1/GRB2 docking), whereas confusables cover ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4 signaling and PLCγ/PI3K branches.

name: Glutamate and aspartate membrane transport and reuptake
rationale: Members are glutamate/aspartate uptake, homeostasis and transporter diseases (SLC1A1, SLC1A3, SLC17A8), distinguishing them from GABA and glycine transport and metabolism in the confusables.

core: Caspase-8 and RIPK1 cell death signaling
qualifier: apoptosis versus necroptosis, including TLR3-TRIF and viral modulation
name: Caspase-8/RIPK1 control of apoptosis versus necroptosis
rationale: Members cover procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP and CASP8 inhibition, TRAIL, TRIF/TLR3-induced death and RIPK1 necroptosis, which separates them from Fas/BID extrinsic apoptosis and TBK1-IRF3 confusables.

qualifier: through the nuclear pore, with gene tethering at the periphery
name: Nuclear pore mRNA export and nuclear-periphery gene tethering
rationale: Most members are mature mRNA export routes and their regulation, alongside nuclear pore-linked gene tethering and transcription, unlike confusables on ribosome/tRNA export, RNA processing, transcription or mRNA decay.

qualifier: via TRAF3/TRAF6 and its viral antagonism
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling via TRAF3/TRAF6 and viral antagonism
rationale: Members cover RLR signaling to IRF and NF-κB through TRAF3/TRAF6, its negative regulators and RSV/SARS-CoV modulation, whereas confusables address ISG effector responses, dsRNA sensing or TBK1-IRF3 and IFN production.

name: Glycosphingolipid and GPI anchor biosynthesis and transport
rationale: Members synthesize, attach or transfer glycolipids (GPI anchors, gangliosides, galactosylceramide, C1P), distinguishing them from lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism, nucleotide-sugar transport and protein palmitoylation.

qualifier: de novo ribonucleotide synthesis and pyrimidine degradation
name: De novo purine/pyrimidine synthesis and pyrimidine degradation
rationale: Members are de novo purine and pyrimidine biosynthesis plus pyrimidine nucleotide/nucleobase catabolism, unlike confusables focused on NDP/NTP interconversion and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

name: Drug and xenobiotic membrane transport via organic anion transporters
rationale: Members are drug ADME, xenobiotic uptake/export and SLCO-mediated organic anion transport (including Rotor hyperbilirubinemia), distinguished from organic cation transport, bilirubin conjugation and xenobiotic enzymatic metabolism.

name: TCA-linked glutamate, aspartate and alanine metabolism
rationale: Members link TCA intermediates (oxaloacetate, malate, 2-oxoglutarate, pyruvate) to glutamate, aspartate and alanine via transamination, the malate-aspartate shuttle and gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on other amino acid catabolism, dicarboxylate transport or OXPHOS.

name: Centriole duplication, microtubule nucleation and spindle positioning
rationale: Members cover centriole duplication and cohesion, MTOC nucleation/anchoring and astral microtubule-based spindle orientation, separating it from tubulin modification, mitotic centrosome maturation, neural progenitor division and cilia confusables.

name: Basement membrane collagen crosslinking and laminin-integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern collagen trimerization, oxidative crosslinking and anchoring fibrils with laminin/integrin and collagen-receptor interactions, distinguishing them from elastic fibre/fibronectin, hemidesmosome and dystroglycan confusables.

name: Inhibitory regulation of striated muscle calcium pump activity
rationale: Members describe dampening calcium ATPase activity, SR calcium uptake and membrane calcium flux in muscle (with fibre-type and myocyte-death effects), unlike confusables on cardiac contraction, rate or channel excitability.

name: ABC transporter-mediated biliary and intestinal lipid efflux
rationale: Members are ABCB4/ABCB11/ABCG5/ABCG8 lipid and sterol export, phospholipid efflux and intestinal cholesterol absorption, unlike confusables on lipoprotein assembly/remodelling and bile acid synthesis/signaling.

core: Gonadal germ cell and somatic cell maturation
name: Gonadotropin-responsive germ cell and gonadal cell maturation
rationale: Members cover FSH/LH responses, follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, germ cell proliferation/migration and Sertoli/Leydig development, distinguishing them from gonadotropin secretion, ovulation/luteinization and sex determination.

name: Adherens junction adhesion and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members are cadherin-mediated adherens junction assembly and regulation plus apical-basal polarity and apical constriction, unlike confusables on desmosomes/hemidesmosomes, CDH1 turnover or tight junctions.

name: Lipoxygenase and cytochrome P450 fatty acid oxygenation
rationale: Members are LOX-derived HETEs, hepoxilins and lipoxins plus CYP epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase products and eicosanoid catabolism, distinguished from cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis, resolvins and PAF metabolism.

name: Membrane tubulation and vesicle budding at endosomes and Golgi
rationale: All three members concern membrane deformation into tubules or buds, whereas confusables address recycling traffic, Rab/ARF signaling and Golgi structural organization.

name: Respiratory burst-mediated neutrophil killing of bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members regulate superoxide generation, respiratory burst and neutrophil cytotoxicity against Gram-negative bacteria and fungi, unlike antimicrobial peptide, degranulation or generic ROS confusables.

name: SLC4-family bicarbonate transport
rationale: All members concern bicarbonate transporters, including SLC4A4 deficiency, distinguishing them from chloride cotransporters, SLC26 anion exchangers, CFTR and CO2/ammonium transport.

name: 5- and 15-lipoxygenase production of HETEs and lipoxins
rationale: Members are 5-HETE and 15-HETE derivative synthesis converging on lipoxin biosynthesis, unlike confusables on omega-3 resolvins, 12-LOX hepoxilins and leukotriene synthesis/catabolism.

name: Cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K isoprenoid metabolism
rationale: Members span mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate synthesis to cholesterol and ubiquinol plus vitamin K metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, separating it from vitamin E, dolichol and CYP-defect confusables.
